raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Reject the generic fused forward when the model's text configuration enables `final_logit_softcapping`. For example, Gemma4 uses `30 * tanh(logits / 30)`, but `dense_common` bypasses the original LM-head forward and computes log-probabilities and entropy without that transformation. This changes the policy distribution and gradients rather than merely introducing floating-point error.

The error is raised before replacing the model class's forward, with instructions to set `actor_rollout_ref.model.use_fused_kernels=False`. This is a correctness guard, not an implementation of fused softcapping. Model-specific forward adapters are unchanged.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Searched for duplicates: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+softcap and https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+gemma4
- [x] Title follows the required format.

This does not duplicate #7657 (FSDP2 KV sharing/backward compatibility), #7131 (attention backend support), or #6715 (multimodal GRPO input support). None adds the missing final-logit softcap or rejects the unsupported generic fused path. #5999 concerns different training/loading failures.

### Test

Executed by the assisting agent:

- `python -m pytest -q tests/models/test_fused_softcap_on_cpu.py`: **24 passed** on CPU.
- `pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure`: **all hooks passed**.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

The CPU regression tests use real Hugging Face configuration/model objects without allocating model weights. They cover top-level Gemma2 and nested Gemma3 text configuration, torch/triton/liger selection, softcapping enabled/disabled, and fused kernels enabled/disabled. Rejection must leave the model forward and backend selection untouched. The existing CPU workflow discovers the `*_on_cpu.py` test automatically. No GPU training or fused-kernel numerical benchmark was run for this guard-only change.

### API and Usage Example

For affected models, use:

```text
actor_rollout_ref.model.use_fused_kernels=False
```

### Design & Code Changes

- Check the effective text config only when selecting the generic fused adapter.
- Document the limitation and workaround in performance tuning guidance.
- Accept 2026 individual-contributor copyright headers in the license checker for the new regression test.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the contribution guide.
- [x] Run pre-commit checks.
- [x] Update documentation.
- [x] Add tests covered by the existing CPU workflow.
- [x] Human submitter has reviewed every changed line and personally run the relevant tests.
- [ ] Request upstream CI when ready; no Slack/Feishu message has been sent.

### AI assistance

This patch, regression test, and description were prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance. The human submitter reviewed the changes and personally reran the CPU regression test command above, reporting completion with all 24 test progress markers passing.

@@ -283,6 +283,14 @@ LigerKernel provides fused Triton kernels (RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE) that can impro
    has finished, and the loaded NVSHMEM host runtime must be compatible with
    the device library used to build the native wheel.
 
+.. note::
+
+    The generic fused output-head implementation does not support models with
+    ``final_logit_softcapping`` enabled, including Gemma variants that use it.
+    Set ``actor_rollout_ref.model.use_fused_kernels=False`` for these models to
+    preserve their log-probabilities and gradients. Selecting another fused
+    backend does not remove this limitation.
+
 Forward prefetch in FSDP training backend

+# Copyright 2026 Individual Contributor: hscspring

+# limitations under the License.
+
+import pytest
+from transformers import Gemma2Config, Gemma3Config, PreTrainedModel
+
+from verl.models.transformers.monkey_patch import patch_forward_with_backends
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", ["torch", "triton", "liger"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("nested", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("softcap", [None, 30.0])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enabled", [False, True])
+def test_generic_fused_softcap(
+    backend: str, nested: bool, softcap: float | None, enabled: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    config = (
+        Gemma3Config(text_config={"final_logit_softcapping": softcap})
+        if nested
+        else Gemma2Config(final_logit_softcapping=softcap)
+    )
+    model = PreTrainedModel(config)
+    original_forward = type(model).forward
+    monkeypatch.setattr(type(model), "forward", original_forward)
+
+    if enabled and softcap:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="use_fused_kernels=False"):
+            patch_forward_with_backends(model, enabled, backend)
+        assert type(model).forward is original_forward
+        assert not hasattr(model, "_verl_fused_kernels_backend")
+    else:
+        patch_forward_with_backends(model, enabled, backend)
+        assert (type(model).forward is original_forward) == (not enabled)
